tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List every Quebec municipality tracked by Gas Quebec, with the citySlug used by the other tools. Prices throughout come from Régie Essence Québec (Régie de l'énergie du Québec).

tools.name: search_locations
tools.description: Search Quebec cities, regions, and gas stations by name. Use this to resolve a user-mentioned place to a citySlug before calling the price tools.

tools.name: find_cheapest_stations
tools.description: Find gas stations near a coordinate in Quebec, ranked by price, distance, or value (price + 1¢/L-per-km detour penalty — the best default for "where should I fill up"). Prices in ¢/L. Sized for one fill-up decision: at most 10 stations within 30 km; for area-wide summaries use get_city_prices instea

tools.name: get_city_prices
tools.description: Current gas price summary for one Quebec city: station count, min/average price per fuel type (¢/L), and the five cheapest stations for regular.

tools.name: get_fill_up_verdict
tools.description: Fair-price assessment and market trend for a Quebec city: whether the current price is fair, and whether to fill up now or wait (based on 30-day history). Fields are null during data gaps.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_locations" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search Quebec cities, regions, and gas stations by name. Use this to resolve a user-mentioned place to a citySlug before calling the price tools.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
